entities.summary: Dapaong is a city in northern Togo and prefecture seat of Tône in the Savanes Region, of which it is also the capital. It had a population of 58,071 at the 2010 Census. It is situated 638 km north of the capital Lomé, near the border with Burkina Faso. It is a market town and has a small museum. Dapaong is a human settlement in West Africa. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
